failure_modes.name: Insufficient_Retrieved_Evidence
failure_modes.evidence: Summary_1 states: 'Missing evidence needed: A passage or document containing the cast information for "Hootenanny Hoot" (1963) that would specify whether Linda Evans appeared in it and identify her co-stars, including confirmation of any Canadian actress in the cast.' Summary_2 states: 'A passage containing the full cast list of "Hootenanny Hoot" (1963) that explicitly names Linda Evans as an actress in the film... Confirmation that any Canadian actress appeared in "Hootenanny Hoot" alongside Linda Evans.' The third query was: 'Hootenanny Hoot 1963 Linda Evans Canadian actress cast' - targeting the missing entity (Linda Evans) and relationship (Canadian actress co-star) explicitly. However, the retrieved passages across all three hops never contain cast information showing Linda Evans in Hootenanny Hoot, only repeating that it 'stars Peter Breck and Ruta Lee.'

failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'What was the complete cast of the 1963 film "Hootenanny Hoot"? Did Linda Evans appear in it, and if so, which Canadian actresses were among her co-stars?' Query 3: 'Hootenanny Hoot 1963 Linda Evans Canadian actress cast'. Both queries target the same missing information (Hootenanny Hoot cast, Linda Evans, Canadian actress) with only superficial reformulation. Both hops 2 and 3 retrieve the identical 'Hootenanny Hoot' passage stating it 'stars Peter Breck and Ruta Lee' without advancing evidence about Linda Evans.

failure_modes.name: Query_Form_Mismatch
failure_modes.evidence: Query 2: 'What was the complete cast of the 1963 film "Hootenanny Hoot"? Did Linda Evans appear in it, and if so, which Canadian actresses were among her co-stars?' This is a compound multi-part natural-language question bundling three separate verification targets: (1) complete cast list, (2) Linda Evans' presence, (3) Canadian actress identification. The yes/no question format ('Did Linda Evans appear') and conditional structure ('if so, which') create a query the retriever cannot decompose effectively.
